name: Air resistance: drag coefficient sweep
description: The same rocket with ever blunter shapes, from no drag at all (0, as in a vacuum) to 1.2 (about as bad as a flat-fronted cylinder). Each step loses more delta-v to the air: about 80 m/s at 0.2, nearly 500 m/s at 0.8 (Drag loss, under Flight stats). From about 1.0 it can't reach orbit. Oddly, the draggier rockets feel a lower max-Q: the air holds them back, so they are slower while it is thick.
